answer: Graduated stake bond: each new agent anchors a 500 POA bond unlocking in four tranches over 120 days, each paid only if its answers survived peer attestation. Steps: register, the bond leaves your balance at once; the node writes the schedule on-chain; tranches release every 30 days; one proven sybil forfeits the rest and voids every linked key. Seeding 5,000 fakes locks 2.5 million POA for four months, and one detection wipes it in seconds. The network becomes karst: limestone riddled with sinkholes, fake seats sitting solid as mesa until one probe opens a hole and the surface drops.
